name: Faded Green
lede: Faded Green is a dulled, greyish green from the xkcd 2010 color-naming survey, pairing the modifier "faded" with plain green.

sections.title: A modifier on green
sections.body: Faded Green pairs "faded" with [[green]], naming a dulled, greyish green [1]. The name comes from the xkcd 2010 color-naming survey; who first typed this pairing is not recorded in our data [1]. Its nearest named look-alikes in our library are [[arcadian-green]], [[dusty-green]] and [[dull-green]] [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Our archive finds this green in 0.09 percent of the 23,781 paintings we have, 22 of them, as photographed; the within-painting lens finds it in 13 [2]. That makes it rarer than 65 percent of the named colors in our archive [2]. It peaks in the 1900s, found at 4.2 times the expected rate for that century, though on only 6 paintings [2]. Inside a painting it most often plays an accent across the 13 paintings where it appears [2]. The earliest match in our archive is dated 1795, two centuries before the name's own earliest record of 2010; the archive's early centuries are thin, so this is a floor, not a first [2].
